decisions.decision: Stability criteria fixed before the stabilised runs finished: (1) epoch-mean domain loss < 2.0 in every epoch, (2) source-val mean macro-F1 >= 0.5 in every epoch

decisions.note: CDAN x10 passes both criteria. DANN x10 FAILS both (diverged from epoch 10; max domain loss ~6951) but its selected checkpoint (epoch 8, source-val F1 0.948) precedes the divergence; it is kept as the main DANN row and flagged unstable rather than iterating further fixes (to avoid tuning).

decisions.decision: DAN lambda=10 collapsed (uniform predictions from epoch 1); kept as-is because it is the controlled-study outcome

Post-evaluation investigation requested by the user. Root cause (source-side diagnostics only): unbounded growth of the 512-d feature scale (frozen backbone BN) lets the backbone beat an unnormalised ReLU discriminator; with disc lr x10 the discriminator's ReLU units all died (output exactly 0, |W1| frozen, domain loss exactly ln 2), so 'discriminator accuracy 0.51' was a dead discriminator, and later reactivation at alpha~0.92 produced the epoch-10 divergence.
decisions.fix_candidate_1: BatchNorm1d in the discriminator hidden layer, discriminator lr = manual 1e-4 (configs dann_discbn, cdan_discbn)
decisions.criteria: unchanged: epoch-mean domain loss < 2.0 every epoch AND source-val mean macro-F1 >= 0.5 every epoch
decisions.main_row_rule: fixed BEFORE the candidate runs finished: a candidate that passes both criteria replaces the disc-lr-x10 variant as the main DANN/CDAN row (it addresses the diagnosed cause with a smaller deviation: lr unchanged). All earlier variants stay reported. Never chosen by Sketch accuracy.
decisions.integrity_note: Sketch labels were already read (2 logged reads) before this investigation; the investigation was triggered by source-side instability and uses no target labels, but it is a post-evaluation rerun and is reported as such.
decisions.decided_by: assistant, on user's instruction to diagnose and fix

decisions.outcome: dann_discbn and cdan_discbn passed both stability criteria (max epoch domain loss 1.18 / 0.78; min source-val F1 0.884 / 0.838) and became the main DANN/CDAN rows per the pre-set rule. Target evaluation (read #3) afterwards showed both are WORSE on Sketch than the disc-lr-x10 variants (DANN 65.2% vs 71.1%; CDAN 51.9% vs 76.6%). The main rows were NOT switched back, because that would be selection by target labels. All variants are reported.
